hr.JobDescription: About NorthLadder NorthLadder, headquartered in Dubai, is the region’s fastest-growing digital platform enabling frictionless pre-owned electronics trade. Most of us know what it feels like to sell a pre-owned device - a smartphone, a laptop, or a tablet. The pre-owned market is in-transparent, and finding a fair price for your asset is daunting. Even if you get a fair price, meeting the buyer, negotiating the price, shipping the asset, and waiting for payment could be exhausting. And then there is the worry of figuring out what happens to the data on your device. This is why NorthLadder came to be. We are the region’s only auction-driven selling platform for pre-owned electronic devices. With our thoughtfully created service, people can sell their devices to a network of global buyers and get cash instantly, safely, dignifiedly, and hassle-free. hr.JobDescription:
Dino Ventures (Indidino Ventures Pvt. Ltd.) is a Bharat-focused, app-first technology company with 5M+ app downloads across a portfolio of 10+ live applications. Our flagship products — including Samaj Saathi, Samjho, and Stick — serve millions of users across India, solving meaningful problems at scale.


We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer with a strong backend focus to architect, own, and ship high-performance features across our growing portfolio of consumer apps.

What You'll Do

  • Architect, build, and scale high-performance, real-time backend systems and APIs powering millions of users
  • Own entire modules or product areas end-to-end with minimal hand-holding
  • Design and optimise relational databases — indexing strategies, query optimisation, and schema design
  • Build and maintain caching layers (Redis), async job processing (BullMQ), and search infrastructure (OpenSearch)
  • Build fast, responsive frontend experiences using modern JavaScript frameworks
  • Lead technical design discussions, make architectural trade-off decisions, and mentor fellow engineers
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to ship impactful user experiences
  • Leverage modern AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to maximise engineering productivity

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch
  • Frontend: SvelteKit, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, tRPC, TanStack Query
  • Cloud: DigitalOcean

Must-Have Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience building and shipping production-grade software at a product company
  • Strong backend engineering depth — any language (Node.js, Python, Java, Go, etc.)
  • Solid SQL/relational database experience — PostgreSQL strongly preferred
  • Hands-on experience with Redis or comparable caching/queue tools (BullMQ, Memcached, Celery, Sidekiq, RabbitMQ, Kafka)
  • Ability to reason through technical trade-offs — can clearly explain why they chose a tool, not just that they used it
  • Working frontend competency in any JavaScript framework (React, Vue, Angular, etc.)
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a module or feature in production
  • Measurable product impact — can speak to outcomes with data (latency improvements, user growth, scale achieved)

Good to Have

  • OpenSearch / Elasticsearch experience
  • SvelteKit experience
  • DevOps / CI-CD pipeline exposure
  • Background in gaming or fintech domains
  • Founding engineer or early employee experience (sub-20-person team)
  • Experience at high-growth startups (Razorpay, Zomato, PhonePe, CRED-tier)
  • TypeScript proficiency
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex)

Why Join Dino Ventures?

  • Build products that solve real problems for millions of Bharat users
  • Work across multiple live products with full ownership from Day 1
  • High ownership, minimal bureaucracy, fast decision-making
  • Shape the technical direction of products used at massive scale
  • Collaborate with an ambitious, product-first engineering team

hr.JobDescription:
ABOUT JUNTRAX SOLUTIONS

Juntrax Solutions is a fast-growing B2B SaaS company building modern, all-in-one business management software for professional services firms — spanning HRMS, Professional Services Automation (PSA), and financial management. We serve SMEs who need enterprise-grade tooling without the enterprise complexity.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Developer who is passionate about building scalable, maintainable applications, writing clean code, and owning technical decisions end-to-end. This role offers significant ownership, a direct path to Tech Lead, and the opportunity to shape the product architecture of a growing platform.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance SaaS application modules across the full stack.

Build robust frontend and backend features using modern JavaScript/TypeScript technologies, ensuring responsiveness, performance, and code quality.

Design and implement secure, versioned REST APIs adhering to industry standards and internal documentation practices.

Write clean, modular, reusable, and well-documented code that follows agreed engineering standards and design patterns.

Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback; actively mentor junior and mid-level developers on best practices.

Participate in system design discussions, sprint planning, and architectural decision-making alongside the engineering team.

Own and resolve production issues — from root cause analysis through to fix, deployment, and post-mortem documentation.

Proactively identify and address performance bottlenecks, scalability gaps, and technical debt across the codebase.

Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Customer Success teams to translate requirements into high-quality engineering deliverables.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes, tooling, coding standards, and CI/CD pipelines.

Maintain and evolve multi-tenant SaaS architecture — ensuring data isolation, security, and scalability across customer tenants.

Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end test coverage to support product reliability.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.

4–6 years of professional full-stack software development experience in a product or SaaS environment.

Proven track record of delivering production-grade features and managing technical complexity independently.

Strong understanding of software architecture principles — SOLID, DRY, separation of concerns, and design patterns.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily standups.

Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with an ability to work through ambiguous requirements.

Strong written and verbal communication skills for collaboration across cross-functional teams.

Demonstrated leadership potential with the ability to mentor peers and grow into a Tech Lead role.


CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS — MUST HAVE


STRONGLY PREFERRED


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


A strong ownership mindset, you take features from idea to production and stand behind them.

Genuine passion for building scalable, reliable software that real users depend on.

Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions without constant supervision.

Exceptional debugging skills and the patience to trace issues methodically to root cause.

A collaborative team player who elevates the people around them through mentorship and knowledge-sharing.

Intellectual curiosity, you stay up to date with the ecosystem and are proactive about adopting better tools and practices.


WHY JOIN JUNTRAX SOLUTIONS?


Work on a meaningful B2B SaaS product used by real professional services firms — not just internal tools.

High ownership and autonomy — your decisions ship to production and you will see their impact.

A clear path to Tech Lead / Engineering Manager as the team scales.

Collaborative, low-bureaucracy startup culture where good ideas are heard and acted on quickly.

Opportunity to shape product architecture from an early stage and leave a lasting technical footprint.

Competitive compensation package with performance-linked growth opportunities.

Senior Backend Engineer


Must-haves for the role


  • 4 - 7 years building production backend systems, with deep, current Node.js + Express expertise (async patterns, streaming, memory/perf, the module ecosystem).
  • Deep MongoDB expertise — schema/data modeling for real workloads, indexing strategy, the aggregation framework, query profiling and optimization, and the operational realities of a database shared by many services. Strong Mongoose experience.
  • TypeScript proficiency and experience migrating JavaScript codebases to it incrementally.
  • Distributed-systems fundamentals — inter-service HTTP contracts, message queues/task backbones, idempotency, retries, caching (Redis), and the failure modes of a shared database.
  • API design and auth — designing clean service APIs practical knowledge of authentication/session models and common web security pitfalls.
  • Cloud + delivery — comfortable with containerized deploys on AWS (ECS or similar) and CI pipelines.

Role: Senior Full-Stack Developer

Location: Remote (India) | Hybrid available for Hyderabad/Nashik

Experience: 6+ years Company: CHRP

Technologies, Inc. (US-based, India engineering team) Reports to: Lead Software Engineer / Director of Engineering

Why CHRP?

CHRP Technologies is reshaping the $1.2 trillion US home insurance industry. Our platform powers the entire home inspection lifecycle —

from scheduling through AI-powered image analysis to automated repair coordination — for some of the largest insurance carriers in the

United States.

What makes us different:

Real impact:

  • Every feature you build is used by thousands of homeowners and insurance professionals daily
  • AI-first product: In-browser ONNX models for image clarity, automated classification of 100+ home condition types, ML-powered
  • scoring
  • Serious scale: 380K+ inspections, 14.5M+ ML-processed images, 9.4M+ inspection photos in production
  • Small team, big ownership: You won't be writing tickets for someone else to build. You'll own features end-to-end — from
  • database schema to production deployment
  • Modern stack: React 18, Node.js 20, MySQL 8, Azure Kubernetes, Stripe, SendGrid, Puppeteer PDF generation — no legacy
  • frameworks


What You'll Work On

  • You'll build and ship features across our three web applications and backend services:
  • Homeowner Portal — The inspection experience homeowners see: photo uploads with real-time AI blur detection, multi-step
  • inspection flows, payment processing via Stripe
  • Insurance Portal — Dashboard used by insurance companies: AG Grid-powered data tables, bulk operations, PDF report
  • generation, real-time inspection tracking
  • Backend APIs — Node.js/Express services: 53 stored procedures, webhook integrations with insurance carriers, BullMQ job queues
  • for email/SMS, read replica routing
  • Recent projects our team shipped:
  • Stripe payment integration with embedded checkout and webhook-based inspection creation
  • ONNX-powered image clarity scoring running in-browser via WebAssembly
  • Westhill Global repair coordination — automated data transfer across 7 service categories
  • Nationwide PolicyCenter integration with mutual TLS and OAuth2

Responsibilities

Build features end-to-end

Design database schemas, write stored procedures, build REST APIs, and ship React UIs

Own the full lifecycle: spec review, implementation, code review, deployment, monitoring

Frontend

  • Build responsive UIs with React 18 (hooks, lazy loading, code splitting)
  • Implement complex forms with react-hook-form + yup validation
  • Work with Material-UI, AG Grid, Handsontable, and ApexCharts

Backend

  • Design and optimize Node.js/Express APIs with MySQL stored procedures
  • Implement webhook integrations with third-party insurance systems
  • Build background job processing with BullMQ (email, SMS, report generation)


Infrastructure

Deploy to Azure Kubernetes Service via Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines

Manage Azure Blob Storage, Redis caching, and MySQL read replicas

Monitor with Prometheus, Winston logging, and Sentry error tracking

Requirements

Must have:

6+ years building production web applications with React.js and Node.js

Strong SQL skills — ability to write and optimize complex MySQL queries and stored procedures

Experience with REST API design and implementation

Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows

Understanding of authentication patterns (JWT, OAuth2, SSO)

Ability to debug across the full stack — browser DevTools, network traces, server logs, database queries

Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup where priorities shift

Good to have:

Experience with Azure services (AKS, Blob Storage, App Insights, DevOps)

Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration

Experience with Stripe or other payment integrations

Exposure to AI/ML pipelines or ONNX runtime

Background in insurance, fintech, or compliance-heavy domains

Experience with Puppeteer/headless Chrome for PDF generation

What We Offer

Competitive salary aligned with experience and market rates

Direct US client exposure — work directly with the US-based product and leadership team

Remote-first culture — work from anywhere in India, with occasional team meetups

Real ownership — no ticket factories. You'll design, build, and ship features that matter

Growth trajectory — early-stage company where your contributions directly shape the product and your career

Learning budget — conferences, courses, and tools that make you better at your craft

Health benefits as per company policy

hr.JobDescription:
Job Description


Senior Full Stack TypeScript Developer


About the Company :

A NYC-based development shop that builds software for fintech startups. The company deploys embedded product delivery teams—combining a Fractional CTO, a Product Delivery Manager, and dedicated engineers—that operate with the speed and accountability of an in-house team. Clients build in verticals including personal finance, banking and lending, capital markets, insurance, and blockchain. Teams ship daily, run 2-week sprints, and maintain a high bar for code quality, testing, and production reliability. The environment is small, fast-paced, and high-trust, suited for senior engineers who thrive in ownership-driven setups.


The Role

As a Senior Full Stack TypeScript Developer, you will be embedded in a client-facing pod responsible for building and shipping production fintech software.

You will work across the entire stack—frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure—delivering features end-to-end from ticket to production.

This is not a passive staff augmentation role. You are expected to understand the product, think critically about edge cases and user experience, and take full ownership of the quality of your output.

You will ship code to real users daily and are accountable for what you ship.


What You Will Do Build and ship features end-to-end.

Take well-defined tickets from Sprint Planning through implementation, testing, code review, and production deployment—typically within 1–2 days per ticket. Write clean, well-tested TypeScript.

Produce code that passes strict TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier checks. Write meaningful unit, integration, and E2E tests as part of every feature PR.

Handle edge cases and error states proactively.

Think about empty states, null values, network failures, permission boundaries, concurrent access, and malformed input before they become bugs in production. Ship incremental, daily releases.

Break work into small, reviewable PRs.

Merge and deploy at least one PR per working day during active Sprints.

Participate in code reviews.

Review teammates’ PRs within 4 hours.

Provide constructive, specific feedback.

hr.JobDescription:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Support Engineer to handle backend debugging, production triage, and performance optimization across our AWS-hosted Node.js, GraphQL, and MongoDB stack.

This role is backend-heavy and critical to maintaining uptime, reliability, and customer satisfaction.

Support Engineers will also contribute a portion of their working hours to Quality Assurance (QA). At our startup’s high pace, maintaining consistent knowledge transfer across releases can be difficult. Hands-on QA participation helps Support Engineers better understand the product, stay aligned with release changes, and act as an implicit knowledge bridge between product, engineering, and support.

You will collaborate closely with engineering, QA, and product teams across US and India time zones to ensure smooth operations and quick resolution of production issues.


Key Responsibilities

  • Diagnose, debug, and resolve backend issues in Node.js and GraphQL services hosted on AWS Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, and CloudFront
  • Write, optimize, and analyze MongoDB aggregation pipelines for analytics, dashboards, and large dataset operations
  • Collaborate with QA teams during pre-release testing to gain hands-on understanding of new features and regression areas
  • Participate in QA test cycles to validate bug fixes, API behavior, and production readiness
  • Review logs and metrics (AWS CloudWatch, ELB, Beanstalk) to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks
  • Work with distributed teams across time zones to ensure smooth handoffs and continuous support coverage
  • Contribute to postmortems, documentation, and long-term reliability improvements
  • Participate in on-call rotations and maintain strong communication during incident response


Technical Skills

Core Expertise:

  • Deep hands-on experience with MongoDB aggregation frameworks and query optimization
  • Proficiency in Node.js (Express / Apollo Server) and GraphQL schema or resolver design


Infrastructure Knowledge:

  • Experience with AWS Beanstalk, EC2, CloudFront, S3, and ELB
  • Familiarity with logging and observability tools such as CloudWatch, New Relic, or Datadog


  • Additional Skills:
  • REST and GraphQL API debugging
  • Understanding of frontend-backend data flow (React familiarity is a plus)
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment troubleshooting


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and debugging mindset
  • Clear communicator across distributed teams
  • Ownership-oriented with a focus on stability and long-term solutions
  • Comfortable working in US primary hours with defined India-time overlap for collaboration
  • Adaptable to startup environments and eager to learn through direct product exposure and QA involvement


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in SaaS or multi-tenant systems
  • Exposure to microservices or event-driven architecture
  • Understanding of data security and compliance standards such as SOC-2 and GDPR


Engagement Type: Fulltime

Direct-hire on the Delightree payroll

Shift time- 11 PM to 4AM IST (Remaining IST Time)

Job Type: Permanent

Location: Remote

Interview Process - 3 Rounds

Delightree aims to eliminate the complexities of multi-unit management, empowering businesses to work smarter and foster growth.

hr.JobDescription:
We seek a motivated, talented, and intelligent individual who shares our vision of being a changemaker. We value individuals dissatisfied with the status quo, strive to make improvements, and envision making significant contributions. We look for those who embrace challenges and dedicate themselves to solutions. We seek individuals who push for data-driven decisions, are unconstrained by titles, and value collaboration. We are building a fast-paced team to shape various aspects of business and technology.




Responsibilities:


Be a part of the initial team to define and set up a best-in-class digital platform for the Private Credit industry, and take full ownership of the components of the digital platform.

You will build robust and scalable web-based applications and need to think of platforms and reuse them.

Driving and active contribution to High-Level Designs(HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs).

Collaborate with frontend developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

Mentor team members in adopting effective coding practices.

Conduct comprehensive code reviews, focusing on both functional and non-functional aspects.

Ensure the security, performance, and reliability of backend systems through proper testing, monitoring, and optimization.

Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and agile development processes to maintain code quality and project timelines.

Simply, be an owner of the platform and do whatever it takes to get the required output for customers.

Be curious about product problems and have an open mind to dive into new domains eg: gen-AI.

Stay up-to-date with the latest development trends, tools, and technologies.



Requirements:


3-5 years of experience in backend development, with a strong track record of successfully architecting and implementing scalable and high-performance backend systems.

Proficiency in at least one backend programming language (e. g., Python, Golang, Node.js, Java) and tech stack to write maintainable, scalable, unit-tested code.

Good understanding of databases (e. g. MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e. g. MongoDB, Elasticsearch, etc).

Solid understanding of RESTful API design principles and best practices.

Experience with multi-threading and concurrency programming.

Extensive experience in object-oriented design skills, knowledge of design patterns, and huge passion and ability to design intuitive module and class-level interfaces.

Experience with cloud computing platforms and services (e. g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).

Knowledge of Test Driven Development.

Experience with microservices architecture.

Knowledge of serverless computing and event-driven architectures (e. g., AWS Lambda, Azure Functions).

Understanding of DevOps practices and tools for continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).

Contributions to open-source projects or active participation in developer communities.

Experience working with LLMs and AI technologies.

company.about:
Empowering Alternative Investors with Agentic Gen-AI: Introducing Binocs.


Binocs is a cutting-edge software platform leveraging agentic Gen-AI to revolutionize Due Diligence and Portfolio Monitoring for Alternative Investors in Private Equity and Private Credit. Recognizing the challenges of manual, time-consuming, and error-prone processes, Binocs offers a powerful automation solution.


Our platform stands out by employing an agentic Gen-AI framework that intelligently mirrors the complex workflows of Alt Funds. This enables rapid and accurate Deal Analysis, encompassing Commercial, Financial, and Operational Due Diligence, alongside continuous and insightful portfolio monitoring.


Binocs is committed to enhancing operational efficiency and strengthening risk management. Our integrated platform automates document management from all sources, utilizes AI and ML to extract and standardize financial statement data for in-depth analysis, and provides robust covenant and ESG monitoring capabilities.
